glosses: To make into, or to become, a nation.

examples.text: Probably no Hindu who could make intelligent use of political freedom ever dreams of the present possibility of a nationalized India, […]

glosses: To bring a private company, or an industry comprising such companies, under the control of a specific government.

examples.text: The government plans to nationalize the energy industry.

glosses: To bring a concept such as a political issue or commercial campaign to the attention of the entire country.
To change from having local and regional variation to being national in character and scope.
To make national; to make a nation of; to endow with the character and habits of a nation, or the peculiar sentiments and attachment of citizens of a nation.
